name: Road Ward
body:
School abjuration; Level adept 2, druid 2, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M/DF (incense of at least 50 gp)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target length of road up to 1 mile/level long and 5 ft. +1 ft./level wide
Duration 1 month/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target road is preserved against natural decay, use, and overgrowth, including plants, animals, and weather. Intentional destruction by creatures with Intelligence 3 or higher is unaffected.

Road ward can be made permanent with a permanency spell, with a minimum caster level of 9 and a cost of 2,500 gp.
